QuestInfo.name: Roly-Poly 9
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 8,393\r\nCan proceed to 'Rolling with Polys 10' quest\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You got a photo of the ninth #bRoly-Poly#k with the camera from Manager Karl. Now go find #bRoly-Poly 10#k on #b#m221020100##k.
QuestInfo.2: You got a photo of #p2040012# on #m221020300#.

0.0: I've really got to find myself a new job. The work here just never ends! Oh! #b#p2040015##k sent you to take a picture of me? Sure, take a good one of me working hard. Now you can go see  #bRoly-Poly 10#k on #b#m221020100##k.

npc.0: Oh, hello there. You're the one who's taking pictures of the 10 of us Roly-Poly workers, right? You should go check out some other Roly-Poly worker now. I'm sure that person's working hard somewhere around Eos Tower.

item.0: Oops, you lost the photo of the previous Roly-Poly? Well, then you just have to go back to Roly-Poly 9 and take another photo. Now I've got to get back to work!

quest.0: Hello! As you can see, I help repair Eos Tower! Oh, #b#p2040015##k sent you here? Hmm, then I think you should visit Roly-Poly 9 on #b#m221020300##k first.

lost.0: Oh no... Did you lose the picture you took with me? We'll have to take another one, then. Please make sure not to lose the picture this time around. Alright, here's a million-dollar pose of me working hard.
